name: IQVIA v Cardiorentis
description: Clinical research services for the TRUE-AHF Phase III trial: IQVIA claims EUR 9,501,587.25 of unpaid invoices, including two milestone earn-back invoices, and Cardiorentis disputes the milestones and sets off damages for allegedly defective trial conduct (pack cut down to the contract, milestone evidence, the complaint and a schedule of outstanding invoices).
